programmes.d: Death changes lives forever as a mystery arises; Scarlett and Gunnar receive an offer from Kelly Clarkson; a video adversely affects Juliette's reputation; Rayna is under intense pressure to succeed.
Zoe decides that it's too soon in her relationship with Judson (Wes Brown) to go to the annual Sweetie Pie Dance, so she makes plans to have a sleepover with Rose (Mckaley Miller).
Wade convinces Lemon to dress up as Joelle (Courtney Parks) as part of a scheme. Lavon asks Zoe to help figure out why Didi (Nadine Velazquez) has been avoiding him.
Snow in BlueBell? Plus, when Lavon's parents (ERNIE HUDSON and VALARIE PETTIFORD) visit BlueBell, Lavon thinks it's the perfect chance to introduce them to Didi (NADINE VELAZQUEZ).
George is named BlueBell's Man of the Year and Lavon is expected to host a cocktail party in George's honor. Zoe steps in to help with the party, but things take a disastrous turn.
Zoe is conflicted about seeing her estranged father (Gary Cole). Lemon tries to befriend Zoe to keep her affair with Lavon a secret. Plus, a cocktail contest at the Rammer Jammer!
Zoe makes a romantic connection with one of her patients, Jesse (JUSTIN HARTLEY). Magnolia (CLAUDIA LEE) has some "interesting" plans in store for Lemon's bachelorette party.
After a night of partying, Wade wakes up with a massive hangover, an uninvited houseguest and no memory of what happened the night before. Scotty Mccreery performs.
Wade must swallow his pride and ask Zoe to be his teammate for the BlueBell Battle. George and Lemon meet with Reverend Mayfair (Peter Mackenzie) to discuss their relationship.
Zoe blames herself when a friend faces a health crisis. Wade explores the idea of opening his own bar in BlueBell. Lemon plans a romantic night for George. Gary Cole guest stars.
In the season finale, George and Lemon prepare for their wedding day and, while taking shelter from a storm, Zoe finds herself stranded in a barn with Wade.
In the season premiere, after George confesses his feelings to Zoe, she must make a tough decision between George and Wade. Golden Brooks (Girlfriends) guest stars.
Rose (Mckaley Miller) enlists Zoe's help in throwing the first BlueBellapalooza and Zoe must ask for Wade's help securing a musical act. Wade convinces George to start dating.
Zoe tries to convince a reporter that she has a thriving medical practice. George informs Lemon that he is going out on a date, making her feel that she too needs to find a date.
While Zoe tries to keep things casual with Wade, she becomes jealous after she sees him with another woman. Lavon reluctantly agrees to let Lemon be his campaign manager.
Zoe is shocked to find that George may be sleepwalking. AnnaBeth (KAITLYN BLACK) has an unusual plan that may help Lavon clinch the mayoral election against Ruby (GOLDEN BROOKS).
